title: Dispelling the Myths of Nuclear Energy (Live Lecture)
summary: A lecture for high school seniors and college freshmen making the case for nuclear power and answering common objections. It is an overview of the channel's more detailed videos on each topic.
why: Pointed to as a lay-audience explanation of nuclear waste, safety and economics.
